errors.text: The initial phase constitution is misidentified as B2/BCC, whereas the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi alloy has an FCC/B2 lamellar structure; the proposed continuous BCC matrix and B2 phase inversion therefore do not correspond to the material.
The proposed SPD plus 1.5–2.5 GPa annealing treatment does not reconstruct the 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment in a hexahedron-anvil apparatus.
The proposed temperature range of 600–800 °C is far below the target condition of 1473 K (1200 °C), and no justified processing duration is given.
The pressure-induced inverted morphology is extrapolated from refractory BCC/B2 alloys without direct evidence that it occurs in the FCC/B2 Al0.7CoCrFeNi system.
The falsification comparison does not cleanly isolate pressure because the high-pressure arm includes severe plastic deformation while the conventional-HIP arm apparently does not.
